objective: Frozen computation: capped growth from one knot (exact to 7, 200 runs to 16); matched starts exact to 10 and 1,000 runs per start with identical seeds and a floor; erasure at n = 8 with a states-only continuation (exact to 11, sampled to 14) and the no-erasure control; caps from the matched starts.
status: Supported 2026-11-18 (referee pending; 4 of 9 predictions held, the proved ones and the main negative among them): the tight caps stop at the 2 x 2 pattern; looser caps pass two orders (c = 9: Q4 at 16 in 191/200); no cap keeps two orders growing; six-starts correspond class for class through n = 9 (same number of orders), five-starts differ in the number of orders (two orders 0.417 vs 0.611 at n = 7), and under c = 5 the six-starts differ (181 vs 95 of 300 at n = 10); after erasure the distance falls 0.78, 0.66, 0.52, 0.41 (six) and 0.65 to 0.20 (five) by n = 11.
title: Capped growth, matched starts and erasure
